daily_challenges.title: FROZEN CIRCUIT
daily_challenges.description: Slow the lane, then turn control into chain damage.
daily_challenges.long_description: Shielded runners arrive quickly and punish a tower that cannot create reaction windows. Freeze or slow first, then convert that control into electric coverage.
daily_challenges.threat_summary: HIGH TEMPO // CONTROL WINDOWS // DAMAGE RESISTANCE

daily_challenges.title: LAST SHELL
daily_challenges.description: Fewer targets. Every armored target matters.
daily_challenges.long_description: The lane is deliberately quiet so every tank and boss becomes a damage check. Build a focused answer for high health and preserve your ultimate for the final threat.
daily_challenges.threat_summary: ARMORED TARGETS // LOW DENSITY // BOSS CHECK
daily_challenges.objective: BREAK ARMOR BEFORE THE BOSS ARRIVES

daily_challenges.title: SWARM PROTOCOL
daily_challenges.description: A railgun must solve its crowd-control problem.
daily_challenges.long_description: Dense groups expose the railgun's weak area coverage. Pierce, bounce, chain, or a wide ultimate must turn a precise weapon into a lane solution.
daily_challenges.objective: CREATE PIERCE, BOUNCE, OR AREA COVERAGE

daily_challenges.title: TOXIC TRANSIT
daily_challenges.description: Displace the enemy, then detonate the poison route.
daily_challenges.long_description: Teleporters and runners break static targeting. Displacement, poison, and control must overlap so enemies remain vulnerable after they jump forward.

daily_challenges.title: BLACKOUT
daily_challenges.description: Ultimate charge is scarce; every activation must count.
daily_challenges.long_description: Shielded enemies and teleporters create disruption while ultimate charge is intentionally precious. Decide whether to save the surge for a boss or spend it to stabilize a wave.
daily_challenges.objective: SAVE THE ULTIMATE FOR THREAT SPIKES

daily_challenges.title: NO SAFE DISTANCE
daily_challenges.description: Fast targets collapse the lane unless control is layered.
daily_challenges.long_description: Runners and teleporters can reach the exit before a slow build stabilizes. Layer stun, slow, rewind, or knockback and protect the few lives available.
daily_challenges.threat_summary: CLOSE PRESSURE // FAST TARGETS // LOW LIVES
daily_challenges.objective: STUN, SLOW, OR PUSH THE FRONT LINE

daily_challenges.title: BURNING ECONOMY
daily_challenges.description: Delayed damage pays dividends when the lane is managed.
daily_challenges.long_description: Burning targets pay for patience, but direct burst is deliberately less reliable. Build a damage-over-time route and decide when economy is worth giving the lane more time.
daily_challenges.loadout_rule: BASTION CHASSIS // CANNON OR FIRE TAGS
daily_challenges.objective: TURN DAMAGE OVER TIME INTO TEMPO
